title: Every point of a stack lies in a locally closed stratum over which it is a gerbe
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks

difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that every point of an algebraic stack lies in a locally closed stratum such that the stack restricted to that stratum is a gerbe over it (author lemma at source lines 6829-6846, label lemma-every-point-in-a-stratum). The proof (source lines 6848-6907) takes the largest open substack on which the inertia is flat and locally of finite presentation, forms the reduced induced closed substack on the complement, notes that the hypotheses persist because the inertia is a base change, and inducts until the quasi-compactness of the space forces termination (proof lines 6848-6906). The open-stratum step and the induction with its termination are the substance. H3.
